text: [{"id":"UC-14","section":"2.4","section_title":"Operating Environment","text":"Admin, Patient can view the invoice and reports for the appointment.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-2.4-1","section":"2.4","section_title":"Operating Environment","text":"The system shall be deployed on a Heroku platform which is a service providing platform to host with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database to maintain the databases.","kind":"constraint","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-2.4-2","section":"2.4","section_title":"Operating Environment","text":"The system shall be accessed via the Hospital’ website which runs on multiple browsers e.g. Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox etc.","kind":"interface","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-2.4-3","section":"2.4","section_title":"Operating Environment","text":"The Operating System on the front-end PCs/Laptops can be MS Windows, Unix, Linux or Apple Mac.","kind":"constraint","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-2.4-4","section":"2.4","section_title":"Operating Environment","text":"Easily invoice and prescription reports can be printed anytime and stored for further need.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]}]
